title: Roadside Response Safety

nodes.text: Contact jurisdictional law enforcement agency if traffic flow is affected

evidence.source_text: Any time traffic flow is affected by the incident, contact the jurisdictional law enforcement agency for assistance.

nodes.text: Conduct operations as far from traffic lanes as possible

evidence.source_text: Conduct all operations as far from traffic lanes as possible.

nodes.text: Wear high visibility vests when working in traffic and not involved in fire suppression

evidence.source_text: When working in traffic and not involved in fire suppression activities, high visibility vests must be worn.

nodes.text: Park vehicles on the same side of the roadway

evidence.source_text: Park vehicles on the same side of the roadway.

nodes.text: Exit the vehicle away from the roadway whenever possible

evidence.source_text: Exit the vehicle away from the roadway whenever possible.

nodes.text: Post lookouts to watch for and control traffic in both directions

evidence.source_text: Post lookouts to watch for and control traffic in both directions.

nodes.text: Utilize road flares or other traffic warning signs

evidence.source_text: Utilize road flares or other traffic warning signs.

nodes.text: Operate pumps from the non-traffic side or from the cab of the fire apparatus

evidence.source_text: Operate pumps from the non-traffic side or from the cab of the fire apparatus.

nodes.text: Keep all hose, fire tools, and equipment out of traffic lanes
